verdict.rationale: Pendo ships its own AI assistant (Leo), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. The only MCP evidence describes Pendo as an MCP server that exposes its data to Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. That is the opposite role, and nothing shows Leo or Pendo connecting to external MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
